text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Traineeeeee-r!
What should I dooooooo!?

One day, Kiseki came dashing in
with tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Graaaagh!
I can't draw at allll!
Nothing's coming to me~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It appears so!
This is a huge deal!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I can't draw my usual art,
and I can't come up with any stories at all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is this... really my limit?
Has my talent dried up...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "No, no, no! I never had much talent to begin with. I'm no genius..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still! I love manga, and I've clung onto this dream the whole time with pure grit and passion!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right...!
It's not like I can't draw anymore.
Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...So embarrassing!

Kiseki said it as if trying to convince herself.
However, I felt the same way.
There was no way she could never draw again.
choice_data_list: I'm sure this slump is only temporary.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right...! I have to
overcome at least this much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm on it!
Operation: Escape the Slump, initiate!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Thank you so much!
Now this is true teamwork!
Having a trainee is so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then let's sit back down at the desk with sheer guts
and squeeze something out somehow!

"How about that method...?
I am no expert on manga, but slumps happen in running too.
At times like that—"
choice_data_list: Let's rethink how we're working at this!
Why not take a bold step away from manga for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see!
It's true, making 'manga' isn't just about sitting at a desk and drawing, is it?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't draw, there must be something I can do...
If I can't draw, then...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna read it!

"And so, we've arrived at the manga cafe!
Here, I can read all sorts of manga and find plenty of inspiration."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Pffft...!
That's too funny...!
Spacing out in "Uma Space"?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah, I guess I've never really read absurd comedy before! It feels kind of fresh.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They've got every volume of the old classics, too!
It's full of things I've always wanted to read... ♪
Ehehe, what should I read next~!

Kiseki silently read her manga.
Laughing, crying, completely engrossed.
And then...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what a read!
That double-page spread was so cool!
I wanna make my next work a battle story like that too...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm, like, getting an itch to draw...!
I feel like I could actually do it right now...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Quick, quick, quick... there...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ta-da! How does it look!?
It's a rough image board for the next work!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
This totally works for me, too!
All right, let's keep this momentum going—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~! I almost missed my stop!
Man, I was totally absorbed in that.
choice_data_list: I guess I'm out of my slump!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I think maybe
what I was lacking was...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was about input...!
Lately, I've been focusing way too much on output!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It really is hard to notice on your own, isn't it?
Thank you so much!
It's all thanks to you, Trainer!
A radiant expression spreads across Kiseki's face. It looks like she managed to break out of her slump!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How to approach this, huh...
Shall we try going back to the basics for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's retrain your sketching fundamentals
from the ground up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm really terrible at this...
My lack of basic skills really hurts...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrrgh!!
One more card!

Groaning and agonizing, Kiseki continued to draw.
She kept trying until it grew dark,
but she was unable to break out of her slump...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A change of pace, you say? How about getting a good, vigorous workout!?
choice_data_list: Right, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.text:
"However, the moment I stepped outside,
the sky clouded over.
Before long, heavy raindrops began to pour."
choice_data_list: I guess exercising like this will be tough...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No! Rain is totally fine.
In fact, it's just right.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll run until I'm so exhausted
I won't even have the energy to worry.
Now, Trainer, go wait somewhere with a roof!

Kiseki dashed off.
Struck by the torrential rain, splashing up mud, running wildly as if releasing all her pent-up emotions...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet, not yet...!
If you give up, that's where the race ends!
Give it everything until my mind goes completely blank...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAHHH--!!
OOOOOOOOHHHHHHH--!!

And... to everyone's surprise, she tripped.
Right into the mud.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I-It hit me...! A tablet... wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOAAAAHHHーーー!

Kiseki started drawing pictures in the mud with her fingers.
Her eyes shone brightly with single-minded focus, looking like she was having the time of her life...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is ittt!!
Trainer! I did it!
Here's the protagonist for my new work!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah!
I've created a masterpiece!
I really am a genius!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stand here!
I need to change quickly and get drawing properly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Thank you so much for putting up with
all this hectic mess!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then!
Please look forward to Kiseki's next work!

Kiseki left like a whirlwind.
I'm left stunned after witnessing a glimpse of that slight madness(?) unique to creators.

"Above, the rain had stopped.
In any case,
it seems Kiseki has broken out of her slump!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see...!
I actually already tried that.
The 'Refresh my mind with something besides manga' plan!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I tried taking walks, cooking, doing handstands, limbo dancing...
But none of it worked at all...!

"Kiseki looked utterly exhausted
from constantly racking her brains.
If so, what she needs might just be rest."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, of course...!
I've been worrying so much lately that I haven't been sleeping well!
It really might just be a lack of sleep!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then it's straight to nap time!
I'll be borrowing that sofa over there for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooooo☆
Late, I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, heroes always arrive late!
The Manga-ichi Budokai!
Time for the final battle~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Lend me your 'miracle'!
With the power of fans across the world, we'll finish this manuscript!
Haaaaaaah!!"
(KABOOOOOOOOOOOOMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

Kiseki suddenly woke up and froze.
Could it be...
choice_data_list: Did you come up with something?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nah, this won't do. Rejected.
Ending on an explosion makes zero sense.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd have a dream with such a terrible plot twist...!
Ugh, my head is spinning.
Mmm, ideas, I need ideas...!"

Whatever dream she had witnessed,
Kiseki remained unable
to break out of her slump...
